    LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.lemma43

    Fischbacher's Lemma 4.3 #

    Let (v α, w β) be an essential contour with value μ ending at a, with arrows α, β. Then α and β are not joined by a walk of arrows into a whose steps are common upper bounds f ≫ αᵢ = g ≫ αᵢ₊₁ ≠ 0 not factoring through μ (lemma43; Fischbacher, Zur Kombinatorik der Algebren mit endlich vielen Idealen, Lemma 4.3: α and β lie in different components of (P/μ)_a). A shortest such walk, closed up by w and v, would form a closed chain unless one of its closing conditions fails, and each failure gives a shorter counterexample.
